title: More Apples
description: Adds material-themed apples with recipes, buffs, ore vision, Bad Apple screen effects, and instant-kill netherite apples for NeoForge.
body:
# More Apples

More Apples is a NeoForge mod that expands the vanilla apple progression with material-themed apples. Each apple is crafted from an apple surrounded by matching ingredients, and enchanted variants use block-tier ingredients with stronger effects and an enchantment glint.

## Features

- Adds black, iron, copper, diamond, emerald, and netherite apple variants.
- Adds crafting recipes and smithing upgrades for netherite apples.
- Adds custom Bad Apple screen effects: grayscale at level 1 and pure black/white at level 2.
- Adds Ore Vision, highlighting nearby ores through blocks while the effect is active.
- Adds Instant Kill on netherite apples, with the effect level decreasing after each kill.

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.11
- NeoForge 21.11.42 or newer within the 1.21.11 line
